subject: VM evidence sidecar + SLA attestation deliverable
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@heliobank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: VM evidence request for SOC2/SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Marcus,

Our audit team at HelioBank just kicked off the annual vendor questionnaire and we need vulnerability management evidence scoped for SOC2, SIG, and CAIQ. Specifically they asked for: a PDF export of the most recent authenticated network+host scan, the cadence (scan schedule and ownership), SLA for critical/important CVEs (time-to-remediate windows and exceptions process), and a simple CVE remediation matrix showing detection -> assign -> fix -> verification.

Can you confirm what you can provide and by when? We have a deadline to upload artifacts into the SIG portal by 2027-06-20.

Thanks,
Jenna
Security Operations
HelioBank

--
Attachment: request-summary-helio-20270610.pdf (summary of asks)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@heliobank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VM evidence request for SOC2/SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Jenna,

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the artifacts you requested and include a concise attestation for HelioBank's audit team. Planned deliverables and ETA: 

- redwood-vm-scan-20270601.pdf — consolidated export of authenticated host+container scans (ETA: 2027-06-13 EOD)
- cve-remediation-matrix-20270613.xlsx — CSV/XLSX showing triage ownership, PR/issue links, and verification evidence (ETA: 2027-06-13 EOD)
- sla-attestation-redwood-20270613.pdf — formal attestation describing our SLA windows for severity tiers and the exceptions/escalation process (ETA: 2027-06-13)

Quick notes on SLA windows (summary): critical CVEs: 48 hours from public disclosure or vendor patch (whichever is later) to mitigation plan initiation and 14 days to mitigation verification; high/important: 30 days to remediation verification; medium/low: scheduled into next maintenance window with documented risk acceptance. We will include the exception playbook for vendor-delivered patches and 3rd-party supply chain constraints.

We will upload artifacts to the shared Drive folder and post links here when ready. If you need a notarized signature or Docusign for the attestation, please let us know.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Dir, Product Security
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment placeholders: redwood-vm-scan-20270601.pdf, cve-remediation-matrix-20270613.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: VM evidence request for SOC2/SIG/CAIQ review — attestation wording

Kimberly / Laura,

Forwarding Jenna's request and our proposed deliverables. Kimberly: can you please review the SLA wording below and confirm compliance language is accurate and defensible for SOC2? We should avoid absolute language around "zero exposure"; stick to process & timelines, compensating controls, and the fallback routing (dedicated vs hosted). Laura: can you verify the list of artifacts is sufficient for SIG upload and that the Drive links will be shareable without extra approvals?

Proposed specific attestation paragraph (draft):

"Redwood Inference attests that, for HelioBank's tenancy and workloads that we serve, vulnerability management is operated with the following service-level commitments: Critical vulnerabilities identified through internal or vendor-supplied sources are triaged within 48 hours and escalated to the remediation roster; remediation verification is completed within 14 calendar days absent vendor dependency or other documented exception; exceptions are recorded and reviewed by our security leadership team. Scheduled authenticated scanning runs at a minimum weekly for host-level assets and nightly for container images in CI/CD, with retention of scan results for 13 months."

Please suggest edits inline. I will incorporate and return the final attestation to Jenna on Monday (13th).

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@heliobank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: VM evidence sidecar + SLA attestation deliverable

Hi Jenna,

Attached are the artifacts for HelioBank's SIG/SOC2 review. We included a short attestation PDF and an indexed remediation matrix that maps each CVE to detection, ticket, PR, and verification evidence. Summary:

- Scan exports: redwood-vm-scan-20270601.pdf (authenticated network + host scan, redacted where necessary for OSINT risk).
- Remediation matrix: cve-remediation-matrix-20270613.xlsx (includes triage timestamps, owner, fix PR links, verification notes).
- SLA attestation: sla-attestation-redwood-20270613.pdf (signed by Product Security leadership).

A few clarifying points we included in the attestation and matrix:
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated host scans; nightly CI image scans — artifacts retained for 13 months.
- SLA windows: critical — 48h to triage + 14 days to verification; high — 30 days to verification; documented exception process for vendor/3rd-party patch dependencies.
- Where an urgent rollback or mitigation is required we have fallback routing to dedicated-capacity customers to apply hotpatches within a prioritized maintenance lane.

Links & delivery: artifacts live in the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-helio-vm
If you need the attestation on company letterhead with a notarized signature or DocuSign, we can route to legal; confirm and we'll expedite.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Dir, Product Security
Redwood Inference
